summary: Iteration 136: Fully validated (a) phone E.164 normalisation + duplicate-account UX, (b) branded security email refactor (hero icons, password-reset confirmation, locale catalogs, render/typecheck/file-size gates), and (c) avatar cross-device sync via server profile. critical_code_review_comments: Playwright route mock note (informational, not a bug): the /api/user/profile request is fired asynchronously after the dashboard mounts (via useDisplayIdentity one-shot fetch). A 5-8s wait after navigation is needed before asserting avatar photo. This is expected because the hook prefers the JWT snapshot first, then hydrates from GET /api/user/profile once — behaviour is correct.
One 403 console error observed after login (likely a background/customer-scope endpoint) — pre-existing, unrelated to this iteration. Not blocking.
